---
title: "EZ Microbial Co-occurrence Network: CLR-Spearman"
output:
  github_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
---

This workflow retains the CLR-Spearman analysis, including network topology,
stage-response connection densities, and paginated recurrent-association heatmaps.
Set `INPUT_DIR` and verify input filenames before rendering.

## Initialization

```{r section-0, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################################################
# EZ ordinary microbial co-occurrence network analysis
# CLR-Spearman analysis
#
# Revision based on EZ_Network_Topology_NoExtraPackage.R
#
# Main revision:
# - Convert the former bacteria-fungi bipartite network into an
#   ordinary undirected weighted network.
# - Test all unique ASV pairs across the combined bacterial + fungal
#   feature table, including:
#       1) Bacteria-Bacteria
#       2) Fungi-Fungi
#       3) Bacteria-Fungi
# - Apply BH-FDR once across all unique pairwise tests in the network.
# - Retain the original sample matching, prevalence filtering,
#   CLR transformation,
#   Spearman correlation, thresholds, and Park x Season recurrence
#   workflow.
# - Export CLR-Spearman results into the original CLR output folder.
# - Summarize four stage-response edge classes and their connection densities.
# - Colour EZ-depleted nodes red, EZ-enriched nodes blue, and non-response
#   nodes grey.
# - Export recurrent-association heatmaps in pages of a fixed maximum
#   number of associations, plus a separate top-30 heatmap.
#   Retain the original page size and export resolution.
# - Record matched sample counts and brewing-cycle coverage for each
#   Park x Season context, without requiring both cycles in every context.
# - Retain the original MIN_GROUP_N = 5 rule for context-level rho and
#   directional-repeatability assessment; smaller groups remain missing.
#
# No additional R packages are introduced.
############################################################

rm(list = ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## User Settings

```{r section-1, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 0. USER SETTINGS
############################

# Set INPUT_DIR to the directory containing the input files.
INPUT_DIR <- "."
OUTPUT_ROOT <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "075EZ_Bacteria_Fungi_Network_Results_Final4")

# Invalidate any previous success marker before dependency checks or analysis.
completion_marker <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "ANALYSIS_COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY.txt")
if (file.exists(completion_marker)) {
  if (!file.remove(completion_marker)) {
    stop("Cannot remove the previous completion marker: ", completion_marker)
  }
}

# CLR-Spearman output folder (original folder name retained).
CLR_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "01_CLR_Spearman_primary")

# Remove previous generated method outputs before a new run, preventing
# outdated heatmaps/tables from remaining when the new run has no result.
RESET_METHOD_OUTPUT_DIRS <- TRUE

METADATA_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "sample_metadata.xlsx")
BACTERIAL_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "16sASV_table.tsv")
FUNGAL_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "ITS_ASV_table.tsv")
STAGE_RESPONSE_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Stage_response_ASVs.xlsx")
# Rename the bacterial taxonomy input to the English filename below,
# or edit this setting to match the actual filename.
BACTERIAL_TAX_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "16sTaxonomy_ASV.tsv")
FUNGAL_TAX_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "ITS_Taxonomy_ASV.tsv")

EZ_LABEL <- "EZ"
PARK_LEVELS <- c("70", "30", "5")
SEASON_LEVELS <- c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")

# Keep the original pre-specified network settings.
MIN_PREVALENCE <- 0.20
MIN_OVERALL_N <- 30
MIN_GROUP_N <- 5               # Minimum n for group-wise rho and repeatability assessment
RHO_THRESHOLD <- 0.7
FDR_THRESHOLD <- 0.05

# Network figure settings.
NETWORK_LAYOUT_METHOD <- "fr"  # "fr" or "kk"
MAX_NODE_LABELS <- 20
NETWORK_PLOT_WIDTH <- 16
NETWORK_PLOT_HEIGHT <- 13

# Split all recurrent associations across multiple heatmaps rather than
# reducing image resolution or compressing the plot.
HEATMAP_MAX_ASSOCIATIONS_PER_PAGE <- 80L
HEATMAP_PNG_DPI <- 300
RANDOM_SEED <- 20261031

# CLR zero handling: fixed additive pseudocount on raw ASV counts.
CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT <- 1
```

## Packages

```{r section-2, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 1. PACKAGES
############################

# The package set is unchanged from the original script.
required_packages <- c(
  "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "igraph", "ggrepel", "readxl"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readxl)
})

set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

dir.create(OUTPUT_ROOT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

if (RESET_METHOD_OUTPUT_DIRS) {
  for (method_output_dir in c(CLR_DIR)) {
    if (dir.exists(method_output_dir)) {
      unlink(method_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

dir.create(CLR_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Input And Transformation Functions

```{r section-3, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 2. INPUT AND TRANSFORMATION FUNCTIONS
############################

read_input_table <- function(file, object_name = "input table") {
  if (length(file) != 1 || is.na(file) || !file.exists(file)) {
    stop(object_name, " file not found: ", paste(file, collapse = ", "))
  }

  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(file))

  if (ext %in% c("xlsx", "xls")) {
    dat <- as.data.frame(
      readxl::read_excel(file, .name_repair = "minimal"),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  } else if (ext == "csv") {
    dat <- read.csv(
      file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
    )
  } else if (ext %in% c("tsv", "txt", "tab")) {
    dat <- read.delim(
      file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
      fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
    )
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file format for ", object_name, ": .", ext)
  }

  dat <- as.data.frame(dat, check.names = FALSE)
  names(dat) <- trimws(sub("^\\ufeff", "", names(dat)))

  if (ncol(dat) == 0) {
    stop("No columns read from ", object_name, ".")
  }

  dat
}


read_asv_count_table <- function(file) {
  dat <- read_input_table(file, "ASV count table")

  if (ncol(dat) < 3) {
    stop("ASV table must contain ASV_ID and at least two sample columns: ", file)
  }

  asv_id <- trimws(as.character(dat[[1]]))

  if (anyNA(asv_id) || any(asv_id == "") || anyDuplicated(asv_id)) {
    stop("ASV_ID is missing or duplicated in: ", file)
  }

  numeric_data <- lapply(dat[-1], function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))
  mat <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(numeric_data, check.names = FALSE))

  if (anyNA(mat) || any(!is.finite(mat)) || any(mat < 0)) {
    stop(
      "ASV count table contains non-numeric, missing, infinite or negative values: ",
      file
    )
  }

  rownames(mat) <- asv_id
  mat
}


read_metadata_table <- function(file) {
  dat <- read_input_table(file, "metadata")

  if (!"Stage" %in% names(dat) && "SampleType" %in% names(dat)) {
    dat <- dplyr::rename(dat, Stage = SampleType)
  } else if ("Stage" %in% names(dat) && "SampleType" %in% names(dat)) {
    if (!identical(
      trimws(as.character(dat$Stage)),
      trimws(as.character(dat$SampleType))
    )) {
      stop("Stage and SampleType columns are both present but differ.")
    }
  }

  dat
}


read_taxonomy <- function(file) {
  if (length(file) != 1 || is.na(file) || !file.exists(file)) {
    return(data.frame(ASV_ID = character(), Genus = character()))
  }

  tx <- read_input_table(file, "taxonomy table")
  nm <- tolower(trimws(names(tx)))

  id_idx <- match(c("asv_id", "asvid", "asv", "feature_id", "otu_id"), nm)
  id_idx <- id_idx[!is.na(id_idx)][1]

  genus_idx <- match(c("genus", "genus_name", "genusname"), nm)
  genus_idx <- genus_idx[!is.na(genus_idx)][1]

  if (is.na(id_idx) || is.na(genus_idx)) {
    nm2 <- tolower(gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "", names(tx)))

    if (is.na(id_idx)) {
      tmp <- match(c("asvid", "asv", "featureid", "otuid"), nm2)
      id_idx <- tmp[!is.na(tmp)][1]
    }

    if (is.na(genus_idx)) {
      tmp <- match(c("genus", "genusname"), nm2)
      genus_idx <- tmp[!is.na(tmp)][1]
    }
  }

  if (is.na(id_idx) || is.na(genus_idx)) {
    stop(
      "Cannot identify ASV_ID and Genus columns in taxonomy file: ", file,
      "\nObserved columns: ", paste(names(tx), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  genus <- trimws(as.character(tx[[genus_idx]]))
  genus <- sub("^g\\s*__\\s*", "", genus, ignore.case = TRUE)
  genus <- trimws(genus)

  unknown <- is.na(genus) | genus == "" |
    tolower(genus) %in% c(
      "unidentified", "unclassified", "uncultured", "unknown",
      "norank", "unassigned", "na", "n/a", "none", "-"
    )

  genus[unknown] <- "Unclassified"

  data.frame(
    ASV_ID = trimws(as.character(tx[[id_idx]])),
    Genus = genus,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ASV_ID), ASV_ID != "") %>%
    distinct(ASV_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}


normalize_domain <- function(x) {
  z <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(z))

  out[z %in% c("b", "bacteria", "bacterial")] <- "Bacteria"
  out[z %in% c("f", "fungi", "fungal", "fungus")] <- "Fungi"

  out
}


read_stage_response <- function(file) {
  x <- read_input_table(file, "Stage-response ASV table")
  required <- c("Domain", "ASV_ID", "Response")

  if (!all(required %in% names(x))) {
    stop(
      "Stage-response file must contain: ",
      paste(required, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (!"Four_season_consistent" %in% names(x)) {
    x$Four_season_consistent <- NA_character_
  }

  x <- x %>%
    transmute(
      Domain = normalize_domain(Domain),
      ASV_ID_input = trimws(as.character(ASV_ID)),
      Response_raw = tolower(trimws(as.character(Response))),
      Four_season_raw = tolower(trimws(as.character(Four_season_consistent)))
    )

  if (anyNA(x$Domain) || anyNA(x$ASV_ID_input) || any(x$ASV_ID_input == "")) {
    stop("Invalid Domain or ASV_ID in Stage-response file.")
  }

  x <- x %>%
    mutate(
      ASV_ID = case_when(
        Domain == "Bacteria" ~ sub("^B_", "", ASV_ID_input, ignore.case = TRUE),
        Domain == "Fungi" ~ sub("^F_", "", ASV_ID_input, ignore.case = TRUE),
        TRUE ~ ASV_ID_input
      ),
      Response = case_when(
        grepl("enrich", Response_raw) ~ "EZ_enriched",
        grepl("deplet", Response_raw) ~ "EZ_depleted",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Four_season_consistent = case_when(
        grepl(
          "not[_ -]?consistent|inconsistent|false|^no$|^n$|^0$",
          Four_season_raw
        ) ~ "No",
        grepl("yes|true|consistent|4.?season", Four_season_raw) ~ "Yes",
        TRUE ~ "Not_available"
      )
    )

  if (anyNA(x$Response)) {
    stop("Response values must indicate EZ-enriched or EZ-depleted ASVs.")
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(paste(x$Domain, x$ASV_ID, sep = "|"))) {
    stop("Duplicated Domain-ASV_ID combinations after prefix normalization.")
  }

  x %>%
    select(Domain, ASV_ID_input, ASV_ID, Response, Four_season_consistent)
}


clr_from_counts_pseudocount <- function(
    counts_taxa_by_sample,
    pseudocount = CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT) {

  # Input: ASVs in rows, samples in columns.
  # Output: samples in rows, ASVs in columns.
  count_matrix <- t(as.matrix(counts_taxa_by_sample))
  storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "numeric"

  if (any(!is.finite(count_matrix)) || any(count_matrix < 0)) {
    stop("Count matrix contains non-finite or negative values.")
  }

  if (any(rowSums(count_matrix) <= 0)) {
    stop(
      "At least one sample has zero reads among prevalence-filtered ASVs; ",
      "CLR cannot be calculated."
    )
  }

  if (length(pseudocount) != 1 ||
      !is.finite(pseudocount) ||
      pseudocount <= 0) {
    stop("CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT must be one positive finite number.")
  }

  # Add the fixed pseudocount to each retained ASV count, then calculate CLR.
  # CLR(x) = log(x) - mean(log(x)) for the ASVs in that sample.
  log_x <- log(count_matrix + pseudocount)
  clr_matrix <- sweep(log_x, 1, rowMeans(log_x), FUN = "-")
  dimnames(clr_matrix) <- dimnames(count_matrix)

  clr_matrix
}


spearman_p_matrix <- function(rho_mat, n) {
  p_mat <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = nrow(rho_mat),
    ncol = ncol(rho_mat),
    dimnames = dimnames(rho_mat)
  )

  if (n <= 2) {
    return(p_mat)
  }

  ok <- is.finite(rho_mat)
  r <- pmin(pmax(rho_mat[ok], -0.999999999), 0.999999999)
  t_stat <- abs(r) * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r^2))
  p_mat[ok] <- 2 * stats::pt(-t_stat, df = n - 2)

  p_mat
}


# Convert a symmetric correlation matrix to one record per unique,
# undirected node pair. BH correction is applied to these unique tests only.
matrix_to_undirected_pairs <- function(rho_mat, p_mat) {
  if (!identical(dim(rho_mat), dim(p_mat))) {
    stop("rho_mat and p_mat dimensions do not match.")
  }

  idx <- which(
    upper.tri(rho_mat, diag = FALSE) & is.finite(rho_mat),
    arr.ind = TRUE
  )

  if (nrow(idx) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      Node1 = character(),
      Node2 = character(),
      Domain1 = character(),
      Domain2 = character(),
      ASV1 = character(),
      ASV2 = character(),
      EdgeID = character(),
      rho = numeric(),
      P_value = numeric(),
      FDR = numeric(),
      Edge_type = character(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  node1 <- rownames(rho_mat)[idx[, 1]]
  node2 <- colnames(rho_mat)[idx[, 2]]
  rho_value <- as.numeric(rho_mat[idx])
  p_value <- as.numeric(p_mat[idx])

  domain1 <- sub("\\|.*$", "", node1)
  domain2 <- sub("\\|.*$", "", node2)
  asv1 <- sub("^(Bacteria|Fungi)\\|", "", node1)
  asv2 <- sub("^(Bacteria|Fungi)\\|", "", node2)

  edge_type <- dplyr::case_when(
    domain1 == "Bacteria" & domain2 == "Bacteria" ~ "Bacteria-Bacteria",
    domain1 == "Fungi" & domain2 == "Fungi" ~ "Fungi-Fungi",
    TRUE ~ "Bacteria-Fungi"
  )

  out <- data.frame(
    Node1 = node1,
    Node2 = node2,
    Domain1 = domain1,
    Domain2 = domain2,
    ASV1 = asv1,
    ASV2 = asv2,
    EdgeID = paste(node1, node2, sep = "||"),
    rho = rho_value,
    P_value = p_value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # One global BH correction across all unique bacterial-bacterial,
  # fungal-fungal and bacterial-fungal tests.
  out$FDR <- stats::p.adjust(out$P_value, method = "BH")
  out$Edge_type <- edge_type

  out %>%
    select(
      Node1, Node2, Domain1, Domain2, ASV1, ASV2,
      EdgeID, Edge_type, rho, P_value, FDR
    )
}


safe_spearman <- function(x, y, min_n = MIN_GROUP_N) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  n <- length(x)

  if (n < min_n || length(unique(x)) < 2 || length(unique(y)) < 2) {
    return(list(rho = NA_real_, n = n))
  }

  list(
    rho = as.numeric(stats::cor(x, y, method = "spearman")),
    n = n
  )
}


save_plot_all_formats <- function(
    plot, file_stem, width, height, dpi = 300) {

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(file_stem, ".png"), plot,
    width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(file_stem, ".pdf"), plot,
    width = width, height = height,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    paste0(file_stem, ".svg"), plot,
    device = grDevices::svg,
    width = width, height = height,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}


make_combined_matrix <- function(bac_mat, fun_mat) {
  if (!identical(rownames(bac_mat), rownames(fun_mat))) {
    stop("Bacterial and fungal matrices do not have identical sample order.")
  }

  bac_use <- as.matrix(bac_mat)
  fun_use <- as.matrix(fun_mat)

  colnames(bac_use) <- paste0("Bacteria|", colnames(bac_use))
  colnames(fun_use) <- paste0("Fungi|", colnames(fun_use))

  combined <- cbind(bac_use, fun_use)
  storage.mode(combined) <- "numeric"

  if (anyDuplicated(colnames(combined))) {
    stop("Duplicated node IDs in the combined matrix.")
  }

  combined
}


make_node_information <- function(
    bac_ids, fun_ids, bac_tax, fun_tax, stage_response) {

  nodes <- bind_rows(
    data.frame(ASV_ID = bac_ids, Domain = "Bacteria"),
    data.frame(ASV_ID = fun_ids, Domain = "Fungi")
  ) %>%
    mutate(node_id = paste0(Domain, "|", ASV_ID)) %>%
    left_join(
      bind_rows(
        bac_tax %>% mutate(Domain = "Bacteria"),
        fun_tax %>% mutate(Domain = "Fungi")
      ),
      by = c("Domain", "ASV_ID")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Genus = ifelse(
        is.na(Genus) | Genus == "",
        "Unclassified",
        Genus
      ),
      Response = "No_stage_response",
      Four_season_consistent = "Not_available"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      stage_response %>%
        select(Domain, ASV_ID, Response, Four_season_consistent),
      by = c("Domain", "ASV_ID"),
      suffix = c("", ".stage")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Response = ifelse(
        !is.na(Response.stage),
        Response.stage,
        Response
      ),
      Four_season_consistent = ifelse(
        !is.na(Four_season_consistent.stage),
        Four_season_consistent.stage,
        Four_season_consistent
      ),
      label = ifelse(
        Genus == "Unclassified",
        ASV_ID,
        paste0(
          Genus, "_",
          sub("^.*?(\\d+)$", "\\1", ASV_ID, perl = TRUE)
        )
      ),
      # Stage-response category is shown by node fill colour only.
      # Four-season consistency is retained in output tables but not displayed.
      label_plot = label
    ) %>%
    select(-Response.stage, -Four_season_consistent.stage)

  nodes
}


annotate_network_edges <- function(edge_table, node_info) {
  node_annotation_1 <- node_info %>%
    transmute(
      Node1 = node_id,
      Genus1 = Genus,
      Response1 = Response,
      FourSeason1 = Four_season_consistent
    )

  node_annotation_2 <- node_info %>%
    transmute(
      Node2 = node_id,
      Genus2 = Genus,
      Response2 = Response,
      FourSeason2 = Four_season_consistent
    )

  edge_table %>%
    left_join(node_annotation_1, by = "Node1") %>%
    left_join(node_annotation_2, by = "Node2") %>%
    mutate(
      Genus1 = ifelse(is.na(Genus1), "Unclassified", Genus1),
      Genus2 = ifelse(is.na(Genus2), "Unclassified", Genus2),
      Direction = ifelse(rho > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
      EdgeLabel = paste0(
        Genus1, " (", ASV1, ") — ",
        Genus2, " (", ASV2, ")"
      )
    )
}


# Classify retained network edges by the stage-response categories of their
# two endpoints and calculate category-specific connection densities.
# Denominators use ALL prevalence-filtered ASVs in node_info, including
# isolated nodes, rather than only nodes that happen to enter the network.
summarize_stage_response_edges <- function(edge_table, node_info) {

  response_levels <- c(
    "EZ_enriched",
    "EZ_depleted",
    "No_stage_response"
  )

  node_counts <- table(
    factor(node_info$Response, levels = response_levels)
  )

  n_enriched <- as.integer(node_counts["EZ_enriched"])
  n_depleted <- as.integer(node_counts["EZ_depleted"])
  n_no_response <- as.integer(node_counts["No_stage_response"])
  n_stage_response <- n_enriched + n_depleted

  edge_out <- edge_table

  if (nrow(edge_out) > 0) {
    edge_out <- edge_out %>%
      mutate(
        Stage_response_edge_category = case_when(
          Response1 == "EZ_enriched" &
            Response2 == "EZ_enriched" ~ "Enriched-Enriched",

          Response1 == "EZ_depleted" &
            Response2 == "EZ_depleted" ~ "Depleted-Depleted",

          (Response1 == "EZ_enriched" &
             Response2 == "EZ_depleted") |
            (Response1 == "EZ_depleted" &
               Response2 == "EZ_enriched") ~ "Enriched-Depleted",

          (Response1 %in% c("EZ_enriched", "EZ_depleted") &
             Response2 == "No_stage_response") |
            (Response2 %in% c("EZ_enriched", "EZ_depleted") &
               Response1 == "No_stage_response") ~
            "Stage response-No response",

          Response1 == "No_stage_response" &
            Response2 == "No_stage_response" ~
            "No response-No response",

          TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
        )
      )
  } else {
    edge_out$Stage_response_edge_category <- character(0)
  }

  category_definitions <- data.frame(
    Category = c(
      "Enriched-Enriched",
      "Depleted-Depleted",
      "Enriched-Depleted",
      "Stage response-No response"
    ),
    Group1 = c(
      "EZ_enriched",
      "EZ_depleted",
      "EZ_enriched",
      "EZ_enriched + EZ_depleted"
    ),
    Group2 = c(
      "EZ_enriched",
      "EZ_depleted",
      "EZ_depleted",
      "No_stage_response"
    ),
    N_nodes_group1 = c(
      n_enriched,
      n_depleted,
      n_enriched,
      n_stage_response
    ),
    N_nodes_group2 = c(
      n_enriched,
      n_depleted,
      n_depleted,
      n_no_response
    ),
    Possible_edges = c(
      choose(n_enriched, 2),
      choose(n_depleted, 2),
      n_enriched * n_depleted,
      n_stage_response * n_no_response
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  observed_counts <- if (nrow(edge_out) > 0) {
    table(
      factor(
        edge_out$Stage_response_edge_category,
        levels = category_definitions$Category
      )
    )
  } else {
    setNames(integer(nrow(category_definitions)), category_definitions$Category)
  }

  category_summary <- category_definitions %>%
    mutate(
      Observed_edges = as.integer(observed_counts[Category]),
      Connection_density = ifelse(
        Possible_edges > 0,
        Observed_edges / Possible_edges,
        NA_real_
      ),
      Total_network_edges = nrow(edge_out)
    ) %>%
    select(
      Category, Group1, Group2,
      N_nodes_group1, N_nodes_group2,
      Observed_edges, Possible_edges,
      Connection_density, Total_network_edges
    )

  audit_summary <- data.frame(
    Total_network_edges = nrow(edge_out),
    Edges_in_four_requested_categories = sum(
      edge_out$Stage_response_edge_category %in%
        category_definitions$Category
    ),
    No_response_No_response_edges = sum(
      edge_out$Stage_response_edge_category == "No response-No response",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Other_unclassified_edges = sum(
      edge_out$Stage_response_edge_category == "Unclassified",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    N_EZ_enriched_nodes = n_enriched,
    N_EZ_depleted_nodes = n_depleted,
    N_No_stage_response_nodes = n_no_response,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(
    edges = edge_out,
    summary = category_summary,
    audit = audit_summary
  )
}
```

## Network Topology Functions

```{r section-4, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 3. NETWORK TOPOLOGY FUNCTIONS
############################

calculate_network_topology <- function(g) {
  if (igraph::vcount(g) == 0 || igraph::ecount(g) == 0) {
    stop("Network topology metrics require at least one node and one edge.")
  }

  # Preserve signed rho in the edge table.
  # Use |rho| as non-negative association strength for weighted topology.
  edge_weight <- abs(igraph::E(g)$rho)
  edge_distance <- 1 / pmax(edge_weight, 1e-8)

  igraph::E(g)$weight <- edge_weight
  igraph::E(g)$distance <- edge_distance

  # Node-level basic metrics.
  degree_value <- igraph::degree(g, mode = "all", loops = FALSE)

  strength_value <- igraph::strength(
    g,
    mode = "all",
    loops = FALSE,
    weights = igraph::E(g)$weight
  )

  # Weighted shortest paths: stronger associations have shorter distances.
  betweenness_value <- igraph::betweenness(
    g,
    directed = FALSE,
    weights = igraph::E(g)$distance,
    normalized = TRUE
  )

  closeness_value <- igraph::closeness(
    g,
    mode = "all",
    weights = igraph::E(g)$distance,
    normalized = TRUE
  )
  closeness_value[!is.finite(closeness_value)] <- NA_real_

  # Harmonic centrality accommodates disconnected graphs.
  distance_matrix <- igraph::distances(
    g,
    v = igraph::V(g),
    to = igraph::V(g),
    weights = igraph::E(g)$distance
  )

  inverse_distance <- 1 / distance_matrix
  inverse_distance[!is.finite(inverse_distance)] <- 0
  diag(inverse_distance) <- 0
  harmonic_value <- rowSums(inverse_distance)

  # Eigenvector centrality is calculated and scaled within each
  # connected component. Values are comparable within, not across,
  # different connected components.
  component_result <- igraph::components(g)
  eigenvector_value <- rep(NA_real_, igraph::vcount(g))

  for (component_id in sort(unique(component_result$membership))) {
    vertex_indices <- which(component_result$membership == component_id)
    subgraph <- igraph::induced_subgraph(g, vids = vertex_indices)

    eigen_result <- tryCatch(
      igraph::eigen_centrality(
        subgraph,
        directed = FALSE,
        weights = igraph::E(subgraph)$weight,
        scale = TRUE
      )$vector,
      error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, length(vertex_indices))
    )

    eigen_result <- as.numeric(eigen_result)

    if (length(eigen_result) != length(vertex_indices)) {
      eigen_result <- rep(NA_real_, length(vertex_indices))
    }

    max_eigen <- suppressWarnings(max(eigen_result, na.rm = TRUE))

    if (is.finite(max_eigen) && max_eigen > 0) {
      eigen_result <- eigen_result / max_eigen
    } else {
      eigen_result[] <- NA_real_
    }

    eigenvector_value[vertex_indices] <- eigen_result
  }

  # Weighted Louvain community detection and modularity.
  # Positive and negative edges both contribute by |rho|;
  # association direction remains separately available in edge tables.
  set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

  community_result <- igraph::cluster_louvain(
    g,
    weights = igraph::E(g)$weight,
    resolution = 1
  )

  community_membership <- igraph::membership(community_result)

  community_size_lookup <- table(community_membership)
  community_size_value <- as.integer(
    community_size_lookup[as.character(community_membership)]
  )

  weighted_modularity <- as.numeric(
    igraph::modularity(
      g,
      membership = community_membership,
      weights = igraph::E(g)$weight,
      resolution = 1,
      directed = FALSE
    )
  )

  node_metrics <- data.frame(
    node_id = igraph::V(g)$name,
    Degree = as.numeric(degree_value),
    Strength = as.numeric(strength_value),
    Betweenness = as.numeric(betweenness_value),
    Closeness = as.numeric(closeness_value),
    Harmonic_centrality = as.numeric(harmonic_value),
    Eigenvector_centrality_componentwise = as.numeric(eigenvector_value),
    Component_ID = as.integer(component_result$membership),
    Component_size = as.integer(
      component_result$csize[component_result$membership]
    ),
    Community_ID = as.integer(community_membership),
    Community_size = community_size_value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  edge_betweenness_value <- igraph::edge_betweenness(
    g,
    directed = FALSE,
    weights = igraph::E(g)$distance
  )

  edge_metrics <- data.frame(
    EdgeID = as.character(igraph::E(g)$EdgeID),
    Weight = as.numeric(edge_weight),
    Distance = as.numeric(edge_distance),
    Edge_betweenness = as.numeric(edge_betweenness_value),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Community-level composition.
  community_ids <- sort(unique(community_membership))

  community_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(community_ids, function(cid) {
    vertex_indices <- which(community_membership == cid)
    subgraph <- igraph::induced_subgraph(g, vids = vertex_indices)
    vertex_domains <- as.character(igraph::V(subgraph)$Domain)

    data.frame(
      Community_ID = as.integer(cid),
      N_nodes = igraph::vcount(subgraph),
      N_bacterial_nodes = sum(vertex_domains == "Bacteria", na.rm = TRUE),
      N_fungal_nodes = sum(vertex_domains == "Fungi", na.rm = TRUE),
      N_internal_edges = igraph::ecount(subgraph),
      Total_internal_abs_rho_weight = sum(igraph::E(subgraph)$weight),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))

  # Connected-component composition.
  component_ids <- sort(unique(component_result$membership))

  component_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(component_ids, function(cid) {
    vertex_indices <- which(component_result$membership == cid)
    subgraph <- igraph::induced_subgraph(g, vids = vertex_indices)
    vertex_domains <- as.character(igraph::V(subgraph)$Domain)

    data.frame(
      Component_ID = as.integer(cid),
      N_nodes = igraph::vcount(subgraph),
      N_bacterial_nodes = sum(vertex_domains == "Bacteria", na.rm = TRUE),
      N_fungal_nodes = sum(vertex_domains == "Fungi", na.rm = TRUE),
      N_edges = igraph::ecount(subgraph),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))

  n_nodes <- igraph::vcount(g)
  n_possible_edges <- choose(n_nodes, 2)
  network_density <- if (n_possible_edges > 0) {
    igraph::ecount(g) / n_possible_edges
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  global_transitivity <- tryCatch(
    igraph::transitivity(g, type = "global", isolates = "zero"),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  average_local_transitivity <- tryCatch(
    igraph::transitivity(g, type = "average", isolates = "zero"),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  domain_codes <- ifelse(
    as.character(igraph::V(g)$Domain) == "Bacteria",
    1L,
    2L
  )

  domain_assortativity <- if (length(unique(domain_codes)) >= 2) {
    tryCatch(
      igraph::assortativity_nominal(
        g,
        types = domain_codes,
        directed = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  topology_summary <- data.frame(
    Network_density = as.numeric(network_density),
    Global_transitivity = as.numeric(global_transitivity),
    Average_local_transitivity = as.numeric(average_local_transitivity),
    Domain_assortativity_nominal = as.numeric(domain_assortativity),
    Mean_degree = mean(degree_value),
    Maximum_degree = max(degree_value),
    Mean_strength = mean(strength_value),
    Maximum_strength = max(strength_value),
    Mean_betweenness = mean(betweenness_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum_betweenness = max(betweenness_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_closeness = mean(closeness_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum_closeness = max(closeness_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_harmonic_centrality = mean(harmonic_value),
    Mean_eigenvector_centrality_componentwise =
      mean(eigenvector_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_communities = length(unique(community_membership)),
    Weighted_modularity_Louvain_abs_rho = weighted_modularity,
    Mean_edge_betweenness = mean(edge_betweenness_value),
    Maximum_edge_betweenness = max(edge_betweenness_value),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(
    nodes = node_metrics,
    edges = edge_metrics,
    community_summary = community_summary,
    component_summary = component_summary,
    summary = topology_summary
  )
}


write_network_metric_definitions <- function(out_dir) {
  definitions <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Degree",
      "Strength",
      "Weight",
      "Distance",
      "Betweenness",
      "Closeness",
      "Harmonic_centrality",
      "Eigenvector_centrality_componentwise",
      "Edge_betweenness",
      "Network_density",
      "Global_transitivity",
      "Average_local_transitivity",
      "Domain_assortativity_nominal",
      "Weighted_modularity_Louvain_abs_rho",
      "Community_ID",
      "Component_ID"
    ),
    Definition = c(
      "Number of incident edges connected to a node.",
      "Sum of absolute Spearman correlation coefficients of edges incident to a node.",
      "Absolute Spearman correlation coefficient for an edge: |rho|.",
      "Inverse absolute correlation: 1/|rho|; used as path length for weighted shortest-path metrics.",
      "Normalized node betweenness based on shortest paths using distance = 1/|rho|.",
      "Normalized closeness based on weighted shortest paths; calculated within the node's reachable component.",
      "Sum of reciprocal finite shortest-path distances; accommodates disconnected components.",
      "Eigenvector centrality calculated separately and scaled to a maximum of 1 within each connected component.",
      "Edge betweenness based on shortest paths using distance = 1/|rho|.",
      "Observed edges divided by all possible undirected edges among network nodes.",
      "Global clustering coefficient (transitivity) of the undirected network.",
      "Mean local clustering coefficient across network nodes.",
      "Nominal assortativity by domain; positive values indicate a tendency for same-domain connections.",
      "Standard undirected weighted Louvain modularity using |rho|.",
      "Louvain community assignment for each node.",
      "Connected-component assignment for each node."
    ),
    Interpretation_note = c(
      "Unweighted node connectivity.",
      "Weighted node connectivity; larger values indicate stronger total absolute association.",
      "Retains association strength but not sign; sign remains in rho/Direction.",
      "Stronger associations are treated as shorter distances.",
      "High values indicate nodes that lie on many weighted shortest paths.",
      "For disconnected graphs, conventional closeness is based on reachable nodes only; interpret with Component_ID.",
      "Useful complementary measure for disconnected networks.",
      "Values are comparable within a component, not across different components.",
      "High values indicate edges that bridge many weighted shortest paths.",
      "Calculated on nodes participating in at least one retained network edge.",
      "Higher values indicate stronger global triangular closure.",
      "Higher values indicate greater local clustering on average.",
      "This is a descriptive network assortativity statistic, not a significance test.",
      "Use as exploratory community structure; positive and negative edges are both weighted by |rho|.",
      "Nodes sharing an ID belong to the same detected community.",
      "Nodes sharing an ID are connected by at least one path."
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    definitions,
    file.path(out_dir, "network_metric_definitions.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Read And Match Samples

```{r section-5, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 4. READ AND MATCH SAMPLES
############################

metadata <- read_metadata_table(METADATA_FILE)

# Brewing-cycle/year information is optional for the network calculation,
# but is recorded to document whether a Park x Season context is represented
# by one or both production cycles.
cycle_candidates <- c("BrewingCycle", "Cycle", "ProductionCycle", "Year")
cycle_col_matches <- cycle_candidates[cycle_candidates %in% names(metadata)]

if (length(cycle_col_matches) > 0) {
  cycle_source_column <- cycle_col_matches[1]
  metadata$BrewingCycle_for_reporting <- trimws(
    as.character(metadata[[cycle_source_column]])
  )
  metadata$BrewingCycle_for_reporting[
    is.na(metadata$BrewingCycle_for_reporting) |
      metadata$BrewingCycle_for_reporting == ""
  ] <- "Unknown"
} else {
  cycle_source_column <- NA_character_
  metadata$BrewingCycle_for_reporting <- "Not_recorded"
}

required_meta <- c("SampleID", "Park", "Season")

if (!"Stage" %in% names(metadata)) {
  stop("Metadata must contain Stage or SampleType (BZ/EZ/PM).")
}

if (!all(required_meta %in% names(metadata))) {
  stop("Metadata must contain: ", paste(required_meta, collapse = ", "))
}

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = trimws(as.character(SampleID)),
    Stage = trimws(as.character(Stage)),
    Park = trimws(as.character(Park)),
    Season = trimws(as.character(Season))
  )

if (anyDuplicated(metadata$SampleID)) {
  stop("Duplicated SampleID in metadata.")
}

metadata_ez_all <- metadata %>% filter(Stage == EZ_LABEL)

if (nrow(metadata_ez_all) == 0) {
  stop("No EZ samples found in metadata.")
}

bac_counts_all <- read_asv_count_table(BACTERIAL_FILE)
fun_counts_all <- read_asv_count_table(FUNGAL_FILE)

missing_bac <- setdiff(metadata_ez_all$SampleID, colnames(bac_counts_all))
missing_fun <- setdiff(metadata_ez_all$SampleID, colnames(fun_counts_all))

zero_depth_bac <- intersect(
  colnames(bac_counts_all)[colSums(bac_counts_all) == 0],
  metadata_ez_all$SampleID
)

zero_depth_fun <- intersect(
  colnames(fun_counts_all)[colSums(fun_counts_all) == 0],
  metadata_ez_all$SampleID
)

valid_bac <- setdiff(colnames(bac_counts_all), zero_depth_bac)
valid_fun <- setdiff(colnames(fun_counts_all), zero_depth_fun)

# Keep each EZ sample when both its bacterial and fungal libraries are
# available. There is NO requirement that every Park x Season context contain
# samples from both brewing cycles; available matched samples from one cycle
# remain eligible for the overall network and context-level correlations.
common_samples <- metadata_ez_all$SampleID[
  metadata_ez_all$SampleID %in% valid_bac &
    metadata_ez_all$SampleID %in% valid_fun
]

if (length(common_samples) < MIN_OVERALL_N) {
  stop(
    "Only ", length(common_samples),
    " matched EZ samples; fewer than MIN_OVERALL_N."
  )
}

metadata_ez <- metadata_ez_all[
  match(common_samples, metadata_ez_all$SampleID),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (any(!metadata_ez$Park %in% PARK_LEVELS)) {
  stop(
    "Unexpected Park labels: ",
    paste(setdiff(unique(metadata_ez$Park), PARK_LEVELS), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (any(!metadata_ez$Season %in% SEASON_LEVELS)) {
  stop(
    "Unexpected Season labels: ",
    paste(setdiff(unique(metadata_ez$Season), SEASON_LEVELS), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

bac_counts <- bac_counts_all[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
fun_counts <- fun_counts_all[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]


# Sample matching/exclusion report.
make_exclusion_rows <- function(domain, ids, reason) {
  if (length(ids) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      Domain = character(),
      SampleID = character(),
      Reason = character(),
      Park = character(),
      Season = character(),
      BrewingCycle_for_reporting = character()
    ))
  }

  data.frame(
    Domain = domain,
    SampleID = ids,
    Reason = reason,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      metadata_ez_all %>%
        select(
          SampleID, Park, Season, BrewingCycle_for_reporting
        ),
      by = "SampleID"
    )
}

exclusion_report <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_exclusion_rows("Bacteria", missing_bac, "Absent_from_ASV_table"),
  make_exclusion_rows("Bacteria", zero_depth_bac, "Zero_library_size"),
  make_exclusion_rows("Fungi", missing_fun, "Absent_from_ASV_table"),
  make_exclusion_rows("Fungi", zero_depth_fun, "Zero_library_size")
)

write.csv(
  exclusion_report,
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "sample_exclusion_report.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Sample number and brewing-cycle coverage in each of the 12 Park x Season
# combinations. A context is not required to contain both cycles.
# Park x Season groups with fewer than MIN_GROUP_N samples remain missing
# in the context-correlation table and heatmaps.
cycle_composition <- metadata_ez %>%
  count(Park, Season, BrewingCycle_for_reporting, name = "N_samples") %>%
  arrange(Park, Season, BrewingCycle_for_reporting)

cycle_composition_collapsed <- cycle_composition %>%
  group_by(Park, Season) %>%
  summarise(
    Cycle_composition = paste(
      paste0(BrewingCycle_for_reporting, "=", N_samples),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sample_n <- expand.grid(
  Season = SEASON_LEVELS,
  Park = PARK_LEVELS,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Context = paste(Park, Season, sep = "-")) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata_ez %>% count(Park, Season, name = "N_matched"),
    by = c("Park", "Season")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cycle_composition_collapsed,
    by = c("Park", "Season")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    N_matched = tidyr::replace_na(N_matched, 0L),
    Cycle_composition = tidyr::replace_na(Cycle_composition, "No matched samples"),
    Evaluable = N_matched >= MIN_GROUP_N
  )

write.csv(
  sample_n,
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "sample_number_by_Park_Season.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  cycle_composition,
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "matched_EZ_sample_cycle_composition.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS <- sum(sample_n$Evaluable)

if (N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS == 0) {
  stop("No Park x Season group meets MIN_GROUP_N.")
}
```

## Prevalence Filtering And Transformations

```{r section-6, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 5. PREVALENCE FILTERING AND TRANSFORMATIONS
############################

# Prevalence is calculated on the matched EZ samples, before transformation.
bac_prevalence <- rowMeans(bac_counts > 0)
fun_prevalence <- rowMeans(fun_counts > 0)

bac_keep <- names(bac_prevalence)[bac_prevalence >= MIN_PREVALENCE]
fun_keep <- names(fun_prevalence)[fun_prevalence >= MIN_PREVALENCE]

if (length(bac_keep) < 2 || length(fun_keep) < 2) {
  stop("Fewer than two ASVs remain in one domain after the 20% prevalence filter.")
}

bac_counts_filt <- bac_counts[bac_keep, , drop = FALSE]
fun_counts_filt <- fun_counts[fun_keep, , drop = FALSE]

if (any(colSums(bac_counts_filt) == 0) ||
    any(colSums(fun_counts_filt) == 0)) {
  stop("At least one sample has zero reads among prevalence-filtered ASVs.")
}

bac_tax <- read_taxonomy(BACTERIAL_TAX_FILE)
fun_tax <- read_taxonomy(FUNGAL_TAX_FILE)
stage_response <- read_stage_response(STAGE_RESPONSE_FILE)

write.csv(
  stage_response,
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "stage_response_ASV_ID_normalized.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    ASV_ID = names(bac_prevalence),
    Prevalence = as.numeric(bac_prevalence),
    Retained = names(bac_prevalence) %in% bac_keep
  ),
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "bacterial_ASV_prevalence.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    ASV_ID = names(fun_prevalence),
    Prevalence = as.numeric(fun_prevalence),
    Retained = names(fun_prevalence) %in% fun_keep
  ),
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "fungal_ASV_prevalence.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# CLR is calculated separately for bacteria and fungi after adding
# the same fixed pseudocount to each retained raw ASV count.
bac_clr <- clr_from_counts_pseudocount(
  bac_counts_filt,
  pseudocount = CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT
)

fun_clr <- clr_from_counts_pseudocount(
  fun_counts_filt,
  pseudocount = CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT
)


# Build the combined CLR matrix for ordinary-network correlations.
# The same sample rows are retained; domain prefixes ensure unique node IDs.
all_mat_clr <- make_combined_matrix(bac_clr, fun_clr)

stopifnot(identical(rownames(all_mat_clr), metadata_ez$SampleID))


# Node annotations for the CLR-Spearman network.
node_info <- make_node_information(
  bac_ids = bac_keep,
  fun_ids = fun_keep,
  bac_tax = bac_tax,
  fun_tax = fun_tax,
  stage_response = stage_response
)

write.csv(
  node_info,
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "all_retained_ASV_node_annotations.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Record the fixed settings once for reproducibility.
settings <- data.frame(
  Setting = c(
    "Matched_EZ_samples",
    "Bacterial_ASVs_retained",
    "Fungal_ASVs_retained",
    "Total_ASVs_retained",
    "Prevalence_threshold",
    "Correlation_threshold",
    "BH_FDR_threshold",
    "Minimum_context_sample_size_for_group_correlation_and_repeatability",
    "Evaluable_Park_Season_contexts",
    "Brewing_cycle_metadata_column",
    "CLR_zero_handling",
    "Network_type",
    "BH_FDR_scope"
  ),
  Value = c(
    length(common_samples),
    length(bac_keep),
    length(fun_keep),
    length(bac_keep) + length(fun_keep),
    MIN_PREVALENCE,
    RHO_THRESHOLD,
    FDR_THRESHOLD,
    MIN_GROUP_N,
    paste0(N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS, "/12"),
    ifelse(is.na(cycle_source_column), "Not available", cycle_source_column),
    paste0("Add ", CLR_PSEUDOCOUNT, " to retained raw ASV counts before CLR"),
    "Ordinary undirected weighted network",
    "All unique bacterial-bacterial, fungal-fungal and bacterial-fungal pairs"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  settings,
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "analysis_settings.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("Matched EZ samples: ", length(common_samples))
message("Bacterial ASVs retained (prevalence >= 20%): ", length(bac_keep))
message("Fungal ASVs retained (prevalence >= 20%): ", length(fun_keep))
message("Total retained ASVs: ", length(bac_keep) + length(fun_keep))
message("Evaluable Park x Season groups (n >= ", MIN_GROUP_N, "): ", N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS, "/12")
```

## Core Analysis Function: Clr-Spearman Ordinary Network

```{r section-7, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 6. CORE ANALYSIS FUNCTION: CLR-SPEARMAN ORDINARY NETWORK
############################

run_network_method <- function(
    method_name,
    all_mat,
    out_dir,
    method_title,
    node_info,
    metadata_ez) {

  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  message("\nRunning method: ", method_name)

  # Retain the original analysis function and group-size rule.
  # Copy sample-context information and method settings into the CLR
  # output folder for auditability.
  write.csv(
    sample_n,
    file.path(out_dir, "sample_number_by_Park_Season.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    cycle_composition,
    file.path(out_dir, "matched_EZ_sample_cycle_composition.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  method_settings <- data.frame(
    Method = method_name,
    Minimum_prevalence = MIN_PREVALENCE,
    Minimum_Park_Season_n = MIN_GROUP_N,
    Heatmap_max_associations_per_page = HEATMAP_MAX_ASSOCIATIONS_PER_PAGE,
    Heatmap_PNG_dpi = HEATMAP_PNG_DPI,
    Absolute_rho_threshold = RHO_THRESHOLD,
    BH_FDR_threshold = FDR_THRESHOLD,
    N_evaluable_Park_Season_groups = N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    method_settings,
    file.path(out_dir, "method_analysis_settings.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Calculate the full Spearman correlation matrix among ALL retained ASVs.
  # This includes within-bacteria, within-fungi and cross-domain correlations.
  rho_mat <- stats::cor(
    all_mat,
    method = "spearman",
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )

  p_mat <- spearman_p_matrix(rho_mat, nrow(all_mat))

  # Extract one record for each unique undirected pair and apply one global
  # BH correction across all pairwise tests.
  all_pairs <- matrix_to_undirected_pairs(rho_mat, p_mat)

  write.csv(
    all_pairs,
    file.path(out_dir, "all_pairwise_correlations.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  candidate_edges_raw <- all_pairs %>%
    filter(
      abs(rho) >= RHO_THRESHOLD,
      FDR < FDR_THRESHOLD
    ) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(rho)))

  candidate_edges <- annotate_network_edges(
    candidate_edges_raw,
    node_info
  )

  stage_response_edge_summary <- summarize_stage_response_edges(
    edge_table = candidate_edges,
    node_info = node_info
  )
  candidate_edges <- stage_response_edge_summary$edges

  write.csv(
    stage_response_edge_summary$summary,
    file.path(out_dir, "stage_response_edge_category_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    stage_response_edge_summary$audit,
    file.path(out_dir, "stage_response_edge_category_audit.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  if (nrow(candidate_edges) == 0) {
    warning("No network edges passed the criteria for ", method_name)

    # Export a complete node table even if no edges pass the thresholds.
    nodes_no_edges <- node_info %>%
      mutate(
        In_network = FALSE,
        Degree = 0,
        Strength = 0,
        Betweenness = 0,
        Closeness = NA_real_,
        Harmonic_centrality = 0,
        Eigenvector_centrality_componentwise = NA_real_,
        Component_ID = NA_integer_,
        Component_size = NA_integer_,
        Community_ID = NA_integer_,
        Community_size = NA_integer_
      )

    write.csv(
      candidate_edges,
      file.path(out_dir, "overall_network_edges_annotated.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    write.csv(
      nodes_no_edges,
      file.path(out_dir, "overall_network_nodes_with_stage_response.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    write.csv(
      nodes_no_edges %>%
        select(
          node_id, ASV_ID, Domain, Genus, Response,
          Four_season_consistent, In_network, Degree, Strength,
          Betweenness, Closeness, Harmonic_centrality,
          Eigenvector_centrality_componentwise,
          Component_ID, Component_size, Community_ID, Community_size
        ),
      file.path(out_dir, "network_node_metrics.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    write.csv(
      data.frame(),
      file.path(out_dir, "network_edge_metrics.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    writeLines(
      "No edges passed both the absolute Spearman rho and BH-FDR thresholds; network topology and figures were not generated.",
      con = file.path(out_dir, "no_network_edges.txt")
    )

    empty_summary <- data.frame(
      Method = method_name,
      N_samples = nrow(all_mat),
      N_bacterial_ASVs = sum(node_info$Domain == "Bacteria"),
      N_fungal_ASVs = sum(node_info$Domain == "Fungi"),
      N_candidate_pairs_tested = nrow(all_pairs),
      N_network_edges = 0,
      N_network_nodes = 0,
      N_retained_ASVs = nrow(node_info),
      N_isolated_retained_ASVs = nrow(node_info),
      N_Bacteria_Bacteria_edges = 0,
      N_Fungi_Fungi_edges = 0,
      N_Bacteria_Fungi_edges = 0,
      N_positive_edges = 0,
      N_negative_edges = 0,
      Network_density_all_retained_ASVs = 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    write.csv(
      empty_summary,
      file.path(out_dir, "network_summary.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    return(list(
      method = method_name,
      all_pairs = all_pairs,
      edges = candidate_edges,
      recurrent = candidate_edges,
      nodes = nodes_no_edges,
      context = data.frame(),
      consistency = data.frame(),
      summary = empty_summary
    ))
  }


  ############################
  ## 6.1 BUILD THE ORDINARY NETWORK
  ############################

  # Build vertices directly from the exact endpoints in the edge table.
  # This guarantees every edge endpoint is present in igraph's vertex data.
  graph_edges <- candidate_edges %>%
    transmute(
      # IMPORTANT: igraph::graph_from_data_frame() interprets the FIRST
      # TWO columns as the source and target vertex IDs. Keep from/to first.
      from = as.character(Node1),
      to = as.character(Node2),
      EdgeID = as.character(EdgeID),
      rho = as.numeric(rho),
      Weight = abs(as.numeric(rho)),
      Direction = as.character(Direction),
      Edge_type = as.character(Edge_type)
    )

  active_node_ids <- unique(c(graph_edges$from, graph_edges$to))

  if (anyNA(active_node_ids) || any(active_node_ids == "")) {
    stop("Missing or blank node IDs were found in the retained edge table.")
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(as.character(node_info$node_id))) {
    stop("Duplicated node_id values were found in node_info.")
  }

  annotation_index <- match(
    active_node_ids,
    as.character(node_info$node_id)
  )

  missing_annotation_ids <- active_node_ids[is.na(annotation_index)]

  if (length(missing_annotation_ids) > 0) {
    write.csv(
      data.frame(node_id = missing_annotation_ids),
      file.path(out_dir, "network_nodes_missing_annotation_match.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    warning(
      length(missing_annotation_ids),
      " edge endpoint(s) did not match node_info; fallback annotations ",
      "were used. See network_nodes_missing_annotation_match.csv."
    )
  }

  get_node_annotation <- function(column, fallback) {
    value <- as.character(fallback)
    matched <- !is.na(annotation_index)

    if (any(matched)) {
      source_value <- as.character(
        node_info[[column]][annotation_index[matched]]
      )
      bad <- is.na(source_value) | source_value == ""
      source_value[bad] <- value[matched][bad]
      value[matched] <- source_value
    }

    value
  }

  fallback_domain <- sub("\\|.*$", "", active_node_ids)
  fallback_asv <- sub("^(Bacteria|Fungi)\\|", "", active_node_ids)

  graph_vertices <- data.frame(
    name = active_node_ids,
    ASV_ID = get_node_annotation("ASV_ID", fallback_asv),
    Domain = get_node_annotation("Domain", fallback_domain),
    Genus = get_node_annotation(
      "Genus", rep("Unclassified", length(active_node_ids))
    ),
    label = get_node_annotation("label", fallback_asv),
    label_plot = get_node_annotation("label_plot", fallback_asv),
    Response = get_node_annotation(
      "Response", rep("No_stage_response", length(active_node_ids))
    ),
    Four_season_consistent = get_node_annotation(
      "Four_season_consistent",
      rep("Not_available", length(active_node_ids))
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (anyDuplicated(graph_vertices$name)) {
    stop("Duplicated vertex names were generated for the ordinary network.")
  }

  missing_vertex_ids <- setdiff(
    unique(c(graph_edges$from, graph_edges$to)),
    graph_vertices$name
  )

  if (length(missing_vertex_ids) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Internal graph construction error: edge endpoints are still missing ",
      "from graph_vertices: ",
      paste(missing_vertex_ids, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  active_nodes <- graph_vertices %>%
    transmute(
      node_id = name,
      ASV_ID = ASV_ID,
      Domain = Domain,
      Genus = Genus,
      label = label,
      label_plot = label_plot,
      Response = Response,
      Four_season_consistent = Four_season_consistent
    )

  if (length(missing_annotation_ids) > 0) {
    fallback_node_info <- active_nodes %>%
      filter(node_id %in% missing_annotation_ids) %>%
      transmute(
        ASV_ID = ASV_ID,
        Domain = Domain,
        node_id = node_id,
        Genus = Genus,
        Response = Response,
        Four_season_consistent = Four_season_consistent,
        label = label,
        label_plot = label_plot
      )

    node_info <- bind_rows(node_info, fallback_node_info) %>%
      distinct(node_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    d = graph_edges,
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = graph_vertices
  )

  if (igraph::is_directed(g)) {
    stop("The generated network must be undirected.")
  }

  if (igraph::any_multiple(g)) {
    stop("Duplicated undirected edges detected; check pair extraction.")
  }


  ############################
  ## 6.2 CALCULATE NETWORK TOPOLOGY
  ############################

  topology <- calculate_network_topology(g)

  # Keep all prevalence-filtered ASVs in the node table.
  # ASVs without a retained edge are marked In_network = FALSE.
  nodes_all <- node_info %>%
    left_join(topology$nodes, by = "node_id") %>%
    mutate(
      In_network = node_id %in% active_node_ids,
      Degree = tidyr::replace_na(Degree, 0),
      Strength = tidyr::replace_na(Strength, 0),
      Betweenness = tidyr::replace_na(Betweenness, 0),
      Harmonic_centrality = tidyr::replace_na(Harmonic_centrality, 0)
    )

  nodes_active <- nodes_all %>%
    filter(In_network)

  candidate_edges <- candidate_edges %>%
    left_join(topology$edges, by = "EdgeID")


  ############################
  ## 6.3 EXPORT EDGE, NODE AND TOPOLOGY TABLES
  ############################

  write.csv(
    candidate_edges,
    file.path(out_dir, "overall_network_edges_annotated.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    nodes_all,
    file.path(out_dir, "overall_network_nodes_with_stage_response.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    nodes_all %>%
      select(
        node_id, ASV_ID, Domain, Genus, Response,
        Four_season_consistent, In_network,
        Degree, Strength, Betweenness, Closeness,
        Harmonic_centrality, Eigenvector_centrality_componentwise,
        Component_ID, Component_size, Community_ID, Community_size
      ),
    file.path(out_dir, "network_node_metrics.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    nodes_active,
    file.path(out_dir, "network_nodes_in_graph.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    candidate_edges %>%
      select(
        EdgeID, Node1, Node2, Domain1, Domain2, ASV1, ASV2,
        Genus1, Genus2, Edge_type, rho, P_value, FDR,
        Direction, Weight, Distance, Edge_betweenness
      ),
    file.path(out_dir, "network_edge_metrics.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    topology$community_summary,
    file.path(out_dir, "network_community_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    topology$component_summary,
    file.path(out_dir, "network_component_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write_network_metric_definitions(out_dir)


  ############################
  ## 6.4 OVERALL NETWORK FIGURE
  ############################

  # Pass weights explicitly; topology-function graph attributes are local.
  set.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

  if (tolower(NETWORK_LAYOUT_METHOD) == "kk") {
    layout_xy <- igraph::layout_with_kk(
      g,
      weights = 1 / pmax(abs(igraph::E(g)$rho), 1e-8),
      maxiter = 1000
    )
  } else {
    layout_xy <- igraph::layout_with_fr(
      g,
      weights = abs(igraph::E(g)$rho),
      niter = 5000
    )
  }

  node_plot <- data.frame(
    node_id = igraph::V(g)$name,
    x = layout_xy[, 1],
    y = layout_xy[, 2],
    degree = as.numeric(igraph::degree(g)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    left_join(nodes_active, by = "node_id")

  edge_plot <- candidate_edges %>%
    left_join(
      node_plot %>% select(node_id, x, y),
      by = c("Node1" = "node_id")
    ) %>%
    rename(x1 = x, y1 = y) %>%
    left_join(
      node_plot %>% select(node_id, x, y),
      by = c("Node2" = "node_id")
    ) %>%
    rename(x2 = x, y2 = y)

  label_nodes <- node_plot %>%
    arrange(desc(degree)) %>%
    slice_head(n = min(MAX_NODE_LABELS, nrow(node_plot)))

  p_network <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = edge_plot,
      aes(
        x = x1, y = y1,
        xend = x2, yend = y2,
        color = Direction,
        linetype = Edge_type,
        linewidth = abs(rho)
      ),
      alpha = 0.48
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = node_plot,
      aes(
        x = x, y = y,
        size = degree,
        shape = Domain,
        fill = Response
      ),
      color = "grey25",
      stroke = 0.65
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_nodes,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_plot),
      size = 2.8,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.45,
      point.padding = 0.30,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(Positive = "#238B82", Negative = "#D17A4A"),
      name = "Association direction"
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Bacteria-Bacteria" = "solid",
        "Fungi-Fungi" = "dashed",
        "Bacteria-Fungi" = "dotdash"
      ),
      name = "Connected domains"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        EZ_depleted = "#C85B55",
        EZ_enriched = "#4C91C6",
        No_stage_response = "grey82"
      ),
      breaks = c("EZ_depleted", "EZ_enriched", "No_stage_response"),
      labels = c("EZ-depleted", "EZ-enriched", "No-stage-response"),
      name = "Stage response",
      # Explicitly use filled circles in this legend. Without this override,
      # ggplot2 may draw the fill legend keys with a non-fillable point shape.
      guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          shape = 21,
          colour = "grey25",
          fill = c("#C85B55", "#4C91C6", "grey82"),
          size = 4,
          alpha = 1,
          stroke = 0.7
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(Bacteria = 21, Fungi = 22),
      name = "Domain"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(2.2, 7),
      name = "Degree"
    ) +
    scale_linewidth_continuous(
      range = c(0.2, 1.1),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("EZ ordinary microbial co-occurrence network: ", method_title),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Prevalence >= 20%; |Spearman's rho| >= ", RHO_THRESHOLD,
        "; global BH-FDR < ", FDR_THRESHOLD,
        "; node colours indicate EZ stage-response category"
      )
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 20)
    )

  save_plot_all_formats(
    p_network,
    file.path(out_dir, "Fig_A_overall_EZ_ordinary_cooccurrence_network"),
    NETWORK_PLOT_WIDTH,
    NETWORK_PLOT_HEIGHT
  )


  ############################
  ## 6.5 PARK x SEASON CORRELATION REPEATABILITY
  ############################

  # Recalculate the same overall-network edges within each Park x Season group.
  # The selected edge set is fixed from the overall network; group-wise
  # correlations are used to evaluate directional repeatability.
  context_grid <- expand.grid(
    Season = SEASON_LEVELS,
    Park = PARK_LEVELS,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(Context = paste(Park, Season, sep = "-")) %>%
    left_join(
      sample_n %>% select(Park, Season, N_matched, Cycle_composition),
      by = c("Park", "Season")
    )

  context_rows <- vector(
    "list",
    nrow(candidate_edges) * nrow(context_grid)
  )

  k <- 1L

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidate_edges))) {
    node1_i <- candidate_edges$Node1[i]
    node2_i <- candidate_edges$Node2[i]

    for (j in seq_len(nrow(context_grid))) {
      park_j <- context_grid$Park[j]
      season_j <- context_grid$Season[j]

      idx <- which(
        metadata_ez$Park == park_j &
          metadata_ez$Season == season_j
      )

      # Preserve the original missing-data rule: groups with fewer than
      # MIN_GROUP_N (= 5) matched samples remain NA and appear as missing
      # (grey) heatmap cells.
      if (length(idx) < MIN_GROUP_N) {
        est <- list(rho = NA_real_, n = length(idx))
      } else {
        est <- safe_spearman(
          all_mat[idx, node1_i],
          all_mat[idx, node2_i],
          min_n = MIN_GROUP_N
        )
      }

      context_rows[[k]] <- data.frame(
        EdgeID = candidate_edges$EdgeID[i],
        Node1 = node1_i,
        Node2 = node2_i,
        Domain1 = candidate_edges$Domain1[i],
        Domain2 = candidate_edges$Domain2[i],
        ASV1 = candidate_edges$ASV1[i],
        ASV2 = candidate_edges$ASV2[i],
        Genus1 = candidate_edges$Genus1[i],
        Genus2 = candidate_edges$Genus2[i],
        Edge_type = candidate_edges$Edge_type[i],
        EdgeLabel = candidate_edges$EdgeLabel[i],
        Overall_rho = candidate_edges$rho[i],
        Park = park_j,
        Season = season_j,
        Context = context_grid$Context[j],
        N_context_matched = context_grid$N_matched[j],
        BrewingCycle_composition = context_grid$Cycle_composition[j],
        rho = est$rho,
        n = est$n,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      k <- k + 1L
    }
  }

  context_correlations <- bind_rows(context_rows)

  context_correlations$Context <- factor(
    context_correlations$Context,
    levels = context_grid$Context
  )

  write.csv(
    context_correlations,
    file.path(out_dir, "context_specific_correlations_12_groups.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  ############################
  ## 6.6 DIRECTIONAL CONSISTENCY
  ############################

  consistency_rows <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(candidate_edges)),
    function(i) {

      edge_id <- candidate_edges$EdgeID[i]

      tmp <- context_correlations %>%
        filter(EdgeID == edge_id)

      # Only groups with at least MIN_GROUP_N samples contribute to
      # directional-repeatability assessment. Smaller groups remain missing
      # in the heatmap and are not used to define recurrent associations.
      valid <- tmp %>%
        filter(
          N_context_matched >= MIN_GROUP_N,
          is.finite(rho)
        )

      n_valid <- nrow(valid)

      n_same <- if (n_valid > 0) {
        sum(sign(valid$rho) == sign(candidate_edges$rho[i]))
      } else {
        0L
      }

      data.frame(
        EdgeID = edge_id,
        Node1 = candidate_edges$Node1[i],
        Node2 = candidate_edges$Node2[i],
        Domain1 = candidate_edges$Domain1[i],
        Domain2 = candidate_edges$Domain2[i],
        ASV1 = candidate_edges$ASV1[i],
        ASV2 = candidate_edges$ASV2[i],
        Genus1 = candidate_edges$Genus1[i],
        Genus2 = candidate_edges$Genus2[i],
        Edge_type = candidate_edges$Edge_type[i],
        EdgeLabel = candidate_edges$EdgeLabel[i],
        Overall_rho = candidate_edges$rho[i],
        Overall_FDR = candidate_edges$FDR[i],
        n_valid_contexts = n_valid,
        n_same_direction = n_same,
        Direction_consistency = if (n_valid > 0) {
          n_same / n_valid
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },
        Recurrent_all_evaluable_contexts = (
          n_valid == N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS &&
            n_same == N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  consistency_summary <- bind_rows(consistency_rows) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(Recurrent_all_evaluable_contexts),
      desc(Direction_consistency),
      desc(abs(Overall_rho))
    )

  write.csv(
    consistency_summary,
    file.path(out_dir, "directional_consistency_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  recurrent <- consistency_summary %>%
    filter(Recurrent_all_evaluable_contexts) %>%
    left_join(
      candidate_edges %>%
        select(
          EdgeID, Response1, Response2,
          FourSeason1, FourSeason2, Direction
        ),
      by = "EdgeID"
    )

  write.csv(
    recurrent,
    file.path(out_dir, "recurrent_associations_all_evaluable_contexts.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  ############################
  ## 6.7 RECURRENT-ASSOCIATION HEATMAPS
  ############################

  if (nrow(recurrent) > 0) {

    # Both heatmaps are based on the same set of associations that retain
    # their overall correlation direction in every evaluable Park x Season
    # context. The second heatmap displays the 30 strongest by |overall rho|.
    make_recurrent_heatmap <- function(
        recurrent_subset,
        file_stem,
        plot_title,
        plot_subtitle) {

      recurrent_subset <- recurrent_subset %>%
        arrange(desc(abs(Overall_rho)), desc(Overall_rho), EdgeID)

      edge_order <- as.character(recurrent_subset$EdgeID)
      edge_labels <- setNames(
        as.character(recurrent_subset$EdgeLabel),
        edge_order
      )

      plot_data <- context_correlations %>%
        filter(EdgeID %in% edge_order) %>%
        mutate(
          EdgeID = factor(
            as.character(EdgeID),
            levels = rev(edge_order)
          )
        )

      # Each heatmap contains no more than HEATMAP_MAX_ASSOCIATIONS_PER_PAGE
      # rows. The original row height and label size are retained; no image
      # compression or resolution reduction is applied.
      heatmap_height <- max(
        6,
        2.5 + 0.24 * nrow(recurrent_subset)
      )
      y_label_size <- 7.5

      p_heatmap <- ggplot(
        plot_data,
        aes(x = Context, y = EdgeID, fill = rho)
      ) +
        geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = edge_labels) +
        scale_fill_gradient2(
          low = "#D17A4A",
          mid = "white",
          high = "#238B82",
          midpoint = 0,
          limits = c(-1, 1),
          na.value = "grey88",
          name = "Spearman's rho"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = plot_title,
          subtitle = plot_subtitle,
          x = NULL,
          y = NULL
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(
            angle = 45,
            hjust = 1,
            vjust = 1
          ),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = y_label_size),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right"
        )

      message(
        "Saving heatmap ", basename(file_stem),
        ": ", nrow(recurrent_subset), " associations; height = ",
        round(heatmap_height, 1), " in; PNG dpi = ", HEATMAP_PNG_DPI,
        "."
      )

      save_plot_all_formats(
        p_heatmap,
        file_stem,
        width = 11,
        height = heatmap_height,
        dpi = HEATMAP_PNG_DPI
      )

      data.frame(
        File_stem = basename(file_stem),
        N_associations = nrow(recurrent_subset),
        Height_inches = heatmap_height,
        Y_axis_label_size = y_label_size,
        PNG_dpi = HEATMAP_PNG_DPI,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    recurrent_all <- recurrent %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(Overall_rho)), desc(Overall_rho), EdgeID)

    # Split the complete recurrent-association set into consecutive pages.
    # Ranking is retained across pages: the strongest overall associations
    # appear first. The original page-size parameter is retained.
    page_index_groups <- split(
      seq_len(nrow(recurrent_all)),
      ceiling(seq_len(nrow(recurrent_all)) / HEATMAP_MAX_ASSOCIATIONS_PER_PAGE)
    )
    n_all_pages <- length(page_index_groups)

    all_heatmap_manifest <- lapply(
      seq_along(page_index_groups),
      function(page_i) {
        page_indices <- page_index_groups[[page_i]]
        page_subset <- recurrent_all[page_indices, , drop = FALSE]
        rank_start <- min(page_indices)
        rank_end <- max(page_indices)

        file_stem <- file.path(
          out_dir,
          sprintf(
            "Fig_B1_recurrent_association_heatmap_ALL_part_%02d_of_%02d",
            page_i, n_all_pages
          )
        )

        page_manifest <- make_recurrent_heatmap(
          recurrent_subset = page_subset,
          file_stem = file_stem,
          plot_title = paste0(
            "All recurrent associations (part ", page_i, "/", n_all_pages,"): ",
            method_title
          ),
          plot_subtitle = paste0(
            "Associations ranked by absolute overall Spearman rho; rows ",
            rank_start, "–", rank_end, " of ", nrow(recurrent_all)
          )
        )

        page_manifest$Plot_type <- "ALL_recurrent_associations"
        page_manifest$Page <- page_i
        page_manifest$Total_pages <- n_all_pages
        page_manifest$Rank_start <- rank_start
        page_manifest$Rank_end <- rank_end
        page_manifest
      }
    ) %>%
      bind_rows()

    # Keep the separate top-30 overview figure, using the same 300-dpi
    # export settings as every page of the complete heatmap.
    top30_recurrent <- recurrent_all %>%
      slice_head(n = min(30L, nrow(recurrent_all)))

    top30_file_stem <- file.path(
      out_dir,
      "Fig_B2_recurrent_association_heatmap_TOP30"
    )

    top30_manifest <- make_recurrent_heatmap(
      recurrent_subset = top30_recurrent,
      file_stem = top30_file_stem,
      plot_title = paste0("Top recurrent associations: ", method_title),
      plot_subtitle = paste0(
        "Top ", nrow(top30_recurrent), " of ", nrow(recurrent_all),
        " recurrent associations, ranked by absolute overall Spearman rho"
      )
    )
    top30_manifest$Plot_type <- "TOP30_recurrent_associations"
    top30_manifest$Page <- 1L
    top30_manifest$Total_pages <- 1L
    top30_manifest$Rank_start <- 1L
    top30_manifest$Rank_end <- nrow(top30_recurrent)

    heatmap_manifest <- bind_rows(
      all_heatmap_manifest,
      top30_manifest
    ) %>%
      select(
        File_stem, Plot_type, Page, Total_pages,
        Rank_start, Rank_end, N_associations,
        Height_inches, Y_axis_label_size, PNG_dpi
      )

    write.csv(
      heatmap_manifest,
      file.path(out_dir, "recurrent_association_heatmap_manifest.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

  } else {

    writeLines(
      paste0(
        "No association retained the same direction in all ",
        N_EVALUABLE_CONTEXTS,
        " evaluable Park x Season groups."
      ),
      con = file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_not_generated.txt")
    )
  }


  ############################
  ## 6.8 RUMINococcus-ASSOCIATED ASSOCIATIONS
  ############################

  ruminococcus_all <- candidate_edges %>%
    filter(
      tolower(Genus1) == "ruminococcus" |
        tolower(Genus2) == "ruminococcus"
    )

  ruminococcus_recurrent <- recurrent %>%
    filter(
      tolower(Genus1) == "ruminococcus" |
        tolower(Genus2) == "ruminococcus"
    )

  write.csv(
    ruminococcus_all,
    file.path(out_dir, "Ruminococcus_all_network_associations.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    ruminococcus_recurrent,
    file.path(out_dir, "Ruminococcus_recurrent_associations.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  ############################
  ## 6.9 NETWORK SUMMARY
  ############################

  graph_components <- igraph::components(g)

  edge_type_counts <- table(
    factor(
      candidate_edges$Edge_type,
      levels = c(
        "Bacteria-Bacteria",
        "Fungi-Fungi",
        "Bacteria-Fungi"
      )
    )
  )

  n_possible_pairs_all_retained <- choose(nrow(node_info), 2)
  density_all_retained <- if (n_possible_pairs_all_retained > 0) {
    nrow(candidate_edges) / n_possible_pairs_all_retained
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  network_summary <- data.frame(
    Method = method_name,
    N_samples = nrow(all_mat),
    N_bacterial_ASVs = sum(node_info$Domain == "Bacteria"),
    N_fungal_ASVs = sum(node_info$Domain == "Fungi"),
    N_retained_ASVs = nrow(node_info),
    N_candidate_pairs_tested = nrow(all_pairs),
    N_network_edges = nrow(candidate_edges),
    N_network_nodes = igraph::vcount(g),
    N_isolated_retained_ASVs = nrow(node_info) - igraph::vcount(g),
    N_bacterial_nodes = sum(nodes_active$Domain == "Bacteria"),
    N_fungal_nodes = sum(nodes_active$Domain == "Fungi"),
    N_Bacteria_Bacteria_edges = as.integer(edge_type_counts["Bacteria-Bacteria"]),
    N_Fungi_Fungi_edges = as.integer(edge_type_counts["Fungi-Fungi"]),
    N_Bacteria_Fungi_edges = as.integer(edge_type_counts["Bacteria-Fungi"]),
    N_positive_edges = sum(candidate_edges$rho > 0),
    N_negative_edges = sum(candidate_edges$rho < 0),
    N_connected_components = graph_components$no,
    Largest_component_nodes = max(graph_components$csize),
    N_recurrent_edges = nrow(recurrent),
    Network_density_all_retained_ASVs = density_all_retained,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(topology$summary)

  write.csv(
    network_summary,
    file.path(out_dir, "network_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  list(
    method = method_name,
    all_pairs = all_pairs,
    edges = candidate_edges,
    recurrent = recurrent,
    nodes = nodes_all,
    context = context_correlations,
    consistency = consistency_summary,
    summary = network_summary
  )
}
```

## Run Clr-Spearman

```{r section-8, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 7. RUN CLR-SPEARMAN
############################

# PRIMARY analysis: compositional data handled by independent CLR transforms.
clr_result <- run_network_method(
  method_name = "CLR-Spearman",
  all_mat = all_mat_clr,
  out_dir = CLR_DIR,
  method_title = "CLR-Spearman (primary)",
  node_info = node_info,
  metadata_ez = metadata_ez
)
```

## Session Information And Completion

```{r section-9, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
############################
## 8. SESSION INFORMATION AND COMPLETION
############################

# Do not print a success message if the analysis failed before returning.
if (!exists("clr_result", inherits = FALSE)) {
  stop(
    "Analysis is incomplete: CLR-Spearman did not finish successfully. ",
    "Do not interpret the outputs ",
    "as a completed analysis."
  )
}

if (is.null(clr_result$summary)) {
  stop("Analysis is incomplete: the CLR-Spearman summary is missing.")
}

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  con = file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "sessionInfo.txt")
)

writeLines(
  c(
    "Analysis completed successfully.",
    paste0("CLR-Spearman edges: ", nrow(clr_result$edges)),
    paste0("CLR-Spearman recurrent edges: ", nrow(clr_result$recurrent))
  ),
  con = file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "ANALYSIS_COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY.txt")
)

message("\nAnalysis completed successfully.")
message("CLR-Spearman primary results: ", CLR_DIR)
message(
  "Brewing-cycle coverage: ",
  file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT, "sample_number_by_Park_Season.csv")
)
message(
  "Stage-response edge category summaries are saved in the CLR-Spearman folder."
)
message(
  "Network type: ordinary undirected weighted network; ",
  "Bacteria-Bacteria, Fungi-Fungi and Bacteria-Fungi edges are allowed."
)
message(
  "Network metrics exported: Degree, Strength, Betweenness, Closeness, ",
  "Harmonic centrality, component-wise Eigenvector centrality, ",
  "edge betweenness, Louvain communities, weighted modularity, ",
  "network density, transitivity and domain assortativity."
)
message(
  "BH-FDR was calculated once across all unique undirected ASV pairs ",
  "in the CLR-Spearman network."
)
```
